name: Dictate Safe
tagline: Dictation for Mac and Windows that runs on your computer
maker_comment_excerpt: Hi Product Hunt, I'm Umesh, founder of Vibhaga Group. Dictate Safe began with our own clients. Their data is not allowed to leave their own systems, so their teams could not use the usual dictation apps. We built one where the speech engine runs on your own computer, and what you dictate never reaches us.
